english: A heavy old workbench, built by hand and used for fifty years. It works like a workbench, but crafts 20% faster, and a weapon, tool or armor piece made on it has a 10% chance to come out one quality higher.\n\nFound, not crafted.
A blackened, patched-up forge that draws like a chimney. It works like a forge, but smelts 50% faster, and its fuel lasts 25% longer.\n\nFound, not crafted.

A chemistry station kept spotless by someone who knew what they were doing. It works like a chemistry station, but crafts 20% faster, and each craft has a 15% chance to come out twice.\n\nFound, not crafted.
An oversized contractor's cement mixer. It works like a cement mixer, but mixes twice as fast, and each batch has a 10% chance to come out twice.\n\nFound, not crafted.

A stone hearth that holds its heat like nothing else. It works like a campfire, but cooks 25% faster, its fuel lasts twice as long, and each dish has a 10% chance to come out twice.\n\nFound, not crafted.

A dew collector with a wide funnel and a cleaner catch. It works like a dew collector, but fills a jar in 4 to 7 hours (instead of 6 to 10), and with a tarp each fill gives 3 jars instead of 2.\n\nFound, not crafted.

A hive with an unusually strong queen. It works like an apiary, but makes honey every 32 hours (instead of 48), and its smoker slot works: a smoker halves the flowers each honey takes.\n\nFound, not crafted.
A roomy coop with warm nesting boxes. It works like a chicken coop, but hens lay and moult every 16 hours (instead of 24), and each hen lays 3 eggs instead of 2.\n\nFound, not crafted.

A battle-scarred anvil that's outlived three blacksmiths. Everything it does as an anvil, and everything made at its forge is another 25% faster, with a 10% chance to come out twice.\n\nFound, not crafted.
A huge leather bellows that pumps like a blacksmith's dream. It speeds up smelting twice as much as a vanilla bellows of the same quality.\n\nFound, not crafted.

A thick, glowing-hot crucible. It works like a crucible, but everything that needs one (forged steel and the like) is made 25% faster, and each craft has a 15% chance to come out twice.\n\nFound, not crafted.
A dented enamel stockpot that's made ten thousand meals. Everything it does as a cooking pot, and pot recipes are another 25% faster, with a 10% chance of a second serving.\n\nFound, not crafted.
A heavy cast-iron grill, seasoned black. Everything it does as a grill, and grill recipes are another 25% faster, with a 15% chance of a second serving.\n\nFound, not crafted.

A heavy lab beaker with faded measuring marks. It works like a beaker, but beaker recipes (medicine, paper and the like) are made 25% faster, with a 15% chance to come out twice.\n\nFound, not crafted.
